# Topiqu

> Topiqu is an AI content operations platform for researching, creating, reviewing, translating, publishing, and improving business content.

Topiqu writes articles from a publisher's own knowledge base and live research, reviews and fact-checks them, scores them for SEO and AI answers, translates them into English, Czech, German and French, publishes them on a hosted blog, WordPress or through an API, and measures clicks from Google Search Console and citations in selected OpenAI answers. Plans: Free ($0), Pro ($49/month), Premium ($99/month) and Custom; every new blog starts with a 14-day trial and 5 AI articles.

Topiqu provides a read-only External API v1 for retrieving published articles. The canonical website is https://topiqu.com and the application/API host is https://app.topiqu.com.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://topiqu.com/en): Features, plans and pricing, comparison and FAQ.
- [What's new](https://topiqu.com/en/changelog): Release notes for the product and the public API.

## Developer documentation

- [External API overview](https://topiqu.com/en/docs): Concepts, base URL, versioning, and first request.
- [Authentication](https://topiqu.com/en/docs/authentication): API-key authentication with the `x-api-key` header.
- [Pagination and filtering](https://topiqu.com/en/docs/pagination): Collection pagination and tag filters.
- [Errors and compatibility](https://topiqu.com/en/docs/errors): HTTP errors and compatibility guarantees.
- [Interactive API reference](https://topiqu.com/en/api-reference): Endpoint and schema reference.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 specification](https://topiqu.com/openapi/v1.json): Machine-readable API contract.
- [Changelog](https://topiqu.com/en/changelog): Product and public API changes.
- [Full LLM context](https://topiqu.com/llms-full.txt): Consolidated product and API documentation.
